dedupe_keys.name: central statistical office of trinidad and tobago 2011 housing and population census redatam database with building type year built wall and roof material water supply source and frequency of public water supply toilet lighting and fuel by municipality community and enumeration district

description: The Central Statistical Office (CSO) of Trinidad and Tobago published its 2011 Housing and Population Census as a REDATAM database on the ECLAC-CELADE webserver, with the 2000 census in a second base. The database keeps a building level, with building type, year built and outer wall and roof material, and a dwelling level with tenure, rooms, source of water supply, how often the public water supply runs, toilet facilities, type of lighting and fuel. Coverage is national; the geography nests municipalities, communities and enumeration districts, so tables can be produced for named communities. The frequency of public water supply variable is uncommon in censuses and describes intermittent supply directly. Format and access: free online frequencies, cross tabulations and area lists without registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: building and dwelling records carry weights, which suggests some adjustment, and the 2011 base is now more than a decade old; newer census products were not identified on the pages read. Simulation uses: community-level intermittent water supply for network reliability and demand studies, and building age and materials for hurricane and earthquake exposure. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub and the Saint Lucia 2022 census database with water supply continuity.
